'''2007 Worlds Day 2 David McCune LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David McCune]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif|label=We'll Handle This}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
